ovs_bridge.description: Name of the integration bridge used for internal VM-to-VM communication.

enable_tunneling.description: Enable overlay tunneling (GRE/VXLAN/Geneve) for tenant isolation.

local_ip.description: Local IP address used as the source for tunnel endpoints (required if tunneling enabled).

tunnel_types.description: List of tunnel types to enable for tenant networks (e.g., vxlan, gre, geneve).

items.description: Tunnel protocol name (vxlan, gre, or geneve).

vlan_mapping.description: Enable VLAN mapping for provider networks with segmentation IDs.

enable_isolated_metadata.description: Enable isolated metadata mode (uses patch ports to reach metadata service without flat VLAN).

enable_metadata_proxy.description: Enable metadata proxy to forward tenant metadata requests (requires Neutron metadata agent).

flow_limit.description: Maximum number of OpenFlow entries to cache per bridge. Use 0 for unlimited.

ovsdb_connection_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for reconnecting to OVSDB after connection loss.

log_rate_limit.description: Maximum log messages per second per module before throttling.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL.

enable_security_group.description: Enable Neutron security groups for VM port filtering.

firewall_driver.description: Firewall backend driver: iptables_hybrid, iptables, or noop.

ipset_fuzzy_match.description: Enable fuzzy matching for ipset-based security group rules (requires ipset support).

type_drivers.description: List of enabled network type drivers (e.g., flat, vlan, vxlan, geneve).

tenant_network_types.description: Ordered list of network types to allocate for tenant networks.

items.description: Tenant network type: vxlan, gre, vlan, or flat.

mechanism_drivers.description: List of mechanism drivers to use (e.g., openvswitch, linuxbridge, sriovnic).

bridge_mappings.description: Mappings from physical network names to OVS bridges (e.g., physnet1 → br-ex).

network.description: Physical network name (matches provider network name).

bridge.description: Name of the OVS bridge connected to the physical interface.

device_mappings.description: Mappings from physical network names to underlying network devices (e.g., eth0).

network.description: Physical network name (must match a bridge_mappings.network).

device.description: Network interface name (e.g., eth1) to attach to the bridge.

enable_l3_agent_extension.description: Enable L3 agent extension to handle routing/NAT via neutron-l3-agent.

enable_dhcp_agent_extension.description: Enable DHCP agent extension to handle tenant network DHCP via neutron-dhcp-agent.

enable_metering_extension.description: Enable metering extension for traffic accounting (requires neutron-metering-agent).
